attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Kopran Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Kopran Limited has submitted their response.
voiceSummary: Kopran Limited responded to a surveillance query from the National Stock Exchange of India regarding a significant increase in trading volume. The company stated that it has made all required disclosures under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. Kopran confirmed that no material information was withheld that could impact the price or volume of its scrip. The company attributed the volume increase to market forces. The clarification was issued by Company Secretary Sunil Sodhani in response to an email from the NSE Surveillance Department dated November 12, 2026.
